transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor! I’ve been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father’s orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away! What do you have to say for yourself, brother?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I’d say ‘thank you’ to my dear brother, but I don’t think he’d appreciate it.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you?! For what, Thor? For returning to find chaos in my wake? For watching my hard work reduced to soaked parchment and blackened ceilings? Ah, yes, how very generous of you indeed! Pray tell, what grand revelry was so deserving of such destruction?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I think there may have been a party.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A party? Of course, a party. Because why wouldn't a celebration turn our halls into a disaster area? And was this party celebrating something magnificent, or was it simply an excuse to indulge while your memory of responsibility withered away? I'd love to hear what warranted bathing my work in mead and blasting the ceiling into oblivion!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: It seems that a group of rather energetic guests took it upon themselves to enjoy themselves. Little did they know, of course, that my dear brother’s absence meant that they were completely unguarded against my wrathful temper. So, rather than dwelling on their naivety, I’ve decided to embrace this unfortunate predicament and turn it into a fun-filled occasion. I’ve summoned the giants to prepare feasts and entertainments, and I’m sure we’ll have a most memorable evening together. Why don’t you join us, dear brother, and make it a night to remember?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, so the chaos was merely an invitation to revel in further pandemonium! While you conjure feasts and summon giants, who, I'm sure, will exercise the utmost care with our fragile halls, I'm left to wonder how anyone manages to let you run wild with such celebrations. Perhaps I should remind them of the last time a "fun-filled occasion" resulted in the Bifrost being temporarily misplaced. But no, Thor, I'm not so inclined to join hands and sing through the wreckage. I've already danced to your disastrous melody—it seems I'll have to add containment of this monumental mess to my list of tasks.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, now you understand my dear brother. No, no, no, I assure you that this time I’ve learned my lesson. I’ve made a solemn vow never to let such chaos occur again. You see, the night of the broken Bifrost was a turning point for me. I realized that my reckless behavior was not only disrespectful but also a threat to our precious realm. And so, I’ve decided to take matters into my own hands. I’ve constructed a new mead-hall, one that is stronger, safer, and more resilient than ever before. Now, let's put the ruins behind us and celebrate in the comfort of my newly crafted hall. Please, dear brother, join us. It's your right as my equal, and I believe you'll find it quite enjoyable.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: You've constructed a new mead-hall, you say? An impressive turnaround surely. Strangely enough, I can't recall seeing so much as a plan laid out for such an engineering feat just weeks ago. But oh, you'll understand if I'm not so eager to waltz into your sanctified den of revelry so soon, lest another "turning point" spirals into further destruction. A trickster may learn a trick or two, yet my eyes shall remain vigilant this time. I will pay a visit and observe from the margins—perhaps witness firsthand this miraculous change you've proclaimed. But I’ll not tolerate another mess for me to clean up. Let's see if your new resolve can match the strength of your promises, brother.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, I understand your hesitation, dear brother. The past is always present, and it takes time to rebuild. But I assure you, this new hall is not built on recklessness. It is designed with utmost care and consideration, ensuring its stability and longevity. You see, I've learned from my mistakes, and I now strive to create structures that withstand the test of time. Rest assured, I won't let disappointment taint your visit. We'll have a celebration worthy of a Thor, and I promise it will be a night to remember. So, let's proceed with caution, and perhaps in due time, we'll see the fruits of our labor. Until then, I'll keep my eyes peeled, my brother, and I'll be here to assist you in any way necessary.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Well then, color me intrigued, Thor. Your lofty words and newfound prudence tempt me to witness this marvel of a mead-hall you've erected. If you've truly channeled all the energy of your chaos into something producible and enduring, it might actually be a sight worth seeing. Understand, though, I harbor reserve company for a reason—you have quite the history of grand claims. But should you prove me wrong, I assure you I'll confess surprise. Your offer of assistance, however, I will not turn away lightly. Let's see how these promises unfold when marshaled in stone and wood. Lead on, brother, show me what you and your "transformative" endeavors have procured.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, I see you're finally ready to step into my new hall, my dear brother. I must say, I'm glad to have your eyes upon it. Prepare yourself, for you're about to witness the marvels of my creation. Follow me, and let the wonders unfold before your eyes.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well, Thor. Lead the way, and may your claims of grandeur meet their match in reality this time. Show me what marvels you've orchestrated, and let's see if they truly transcend mere words. Though I reserve some skepticism, perhaps it will be surpassed by genuine admiration. transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Brilliant, my dear brother! I knew I could count on your discerning gaze. Now, let us enter this new hall and witness the fruits of our labor together. Prepare yourself for a night of celebration, where we shall revel in the splendor of our accomplishments. And remember, I shall be by your side, guiding you through this remarkable journey. Together, we shall make history!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Guidance from someone who revels so naturally is a novel notion, dear brother. But as you say, let's walk this path and see what history is awaiting to be written. I can't deny my curiosity, however cautiously it may be expressed. A night of celebration, indeed — if your well-measured promises hold true, perhaps my next returning journey won't require the rebuilding of what was. Let us see this splendor unfold, my ever-optimistic Thor. Lead on, and may the night be remarkably memorable for the right reasons.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I take your words of caution, dear brother, as a sign of progress. Let us proceed, then, and together create an evening that shall stand as a testament to our newfound determination. So, let the celebration begin! And let us write a new chapter in our lives, one filled with wisdom, resilience, and camaraderie. Cheers to the future, my dear brother!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
